welcome.heading: Welcome to NicOS!
welcome.text: This is my portfolio, turned into a 1980s computer. Here you'll find my projects, skills, education and ways to reach me.
guide.title: GUIDE
guide.s.welcome:
Let me show you where everything is in a few seconds.
Use the arrow keys or the buttons to move on.
guide.s.about: README.TXT: who I am, what I'm looking for and how to reach me.
guide.s.projects: PROJECTS: everything I've built, organised in folders by area. Each project has a description, images or video and a GitHub link.
guide.s.skills: SKILLS: languages, frameworks and tools. Open any of them to see which projects use it.
guide.s.knowledge: KNOWLEDGE: the areas I master (AI, cybersecurity, distributed systems...) with their key concepts.
guide.s.experience: EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION: my path through my own companies and universities.
guide.s.contact: CONTACT: e-mail, LinkedIn and GitHub. You can also write a message from here.
guide.s.cv: CV.PDF: download my résumé in Spanish, English, Italian, French or Chinese.
guide.s.widget: This panel sums up what matters: status, location and featured projects.
guide.s.tray: Change the language, the screen colour (green, amber or white) and the sound here.
guide.s.start: The START menu gives access to everything, and lets you restart or shut down the computer.
guide.s.terminal: Prefer the keyboard? Open the TERMINAL and type 'help'.
guide.s.quick: In a hurry? QUICK VIEW prints everything on a single page.
guide.s.office: And outside the screen, the objects in the office are clickable too: the diploma, the map, the Nokia, the floppy disks, the printed CV...
guide.s.end: All set! Double-click any icon to start.
wip.title: Projects under construction
wip.text: I'm currently on exchange at UADE (Buenos Aires), working on new Artificial Intelligence projects (machine learning, heuristic search, genetic algorithms) and API development.
wip.note: They'll show up here once they're finished. Check back soon.
